_note: Chitonga wordings found in the manuscripts themselves (not on the author's form). Added as extra variants. The ECE Learner's Book spells its unit word CIBEELA (the Form 4 author's form gave CIPATI), and titles its front matter MAJWI AANTALISYO / MATALIKILO A BBUKU. The activity word is Cakucita: Chitonga, like Ichibemba, writes the sound with plain c (cita, cibeela, cifwanikiso) — ch is the Cinyanja spelling. An earlier version printed Cakuchita; the author's round-1 proofread (Oct 2026) corrected it back to Cakucita throughout, and the user confirmed. Cakuchita stays recognised so a stray one is corrected.
